items.title: What Does Merck (MRK) Losing Nemtabrutinib Mean For Its Blood Cancer Pipeline?
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) has halted clinical development of its blood cancer drug candidate nemtabrutinib after a recent internal review. The decision ends all Phase 3 BELLWAVE program studies after data indicated the benefit to risk profile did not justify continuation. This move closes out one of Merck's late stage hematology assets and removes a potential future option in its oncology portfolio.
